_comment: The simulated timetool (drp -D tt) for psdaq.sim.rogue_dev: the KCU's TimeToolKcu1500 (AxiMemMap) and the Piranha4 camera behind the camera link FEB on PGP lane 0 (SRPv3 on VC0, the serial port on VC2) of lcls2_timetool.TimeToolKcu1500Root, which psdaq/configdb/tt_config.py builds. Keys are pyrogue register paths; values are what the hardware reports. The lcls2-timetool package bundles a surf that does not work with rogue 6; run with PSDAQ_SIM_PYTHONPATH naming a rogue-6 surf (RUNBOOK).
_RxRemLinkReady: the FEB's PGP2b link is up: tt_connect's 'PGP Link is down' check
_RxId: the XPM's remote link id; the DRP takes the link id simxpm assigns, not this one

replies.gcp:
Model #:	P4_CM_02K10D_00_R
Serial #:	00000001
BiST:	Good
CPA:	0 4095 0
USER>

_uart._comment: the Piranha4's serial console as in piranha4.json: tt_config's cl_poll waits for each command's answer; every command gets 'OK' and the 'USER>' prompt
